note: San Juan NF (Columbine RD) campground at ~9,800 ft along South Mineral Creek, 2 mi west of Silverton on US-550 then 4 mi up Forest Road 585, which the FS says is drivable by 2WD to the campground and becomes 4WD just past it. Spruce-fir shade; a waterfall just upstream; the Ice Lake Trail starts next to the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 26 sites, FCFS only, $40, vault toilets, potable water, no hookups. Added max RV 35 ft (FS), three vault toilets, season (late May through September), fees checked 2026, designated dispersed-area note. Note rewritten: field facts dropped; the 2WD/4WD road wording now matches the FS page.
flags: Phone missing: Columbine Ranger District Office (970) 884-2512 (FS page office contact, Bayfield; 'Hours: Friday only, 10:00am-4:30pm'). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line: 'For facility specific information, please call (661) 702-1420' (goexplorus.com email).
Operator: concessionaire (Explorus, per recreation.gov's contact email) on San Juan NF land; ownership left federal.

Road (no 4WD needed to reach the campground): FS 'follow Forest Road 585 for 4 miles to the campground entrance. The road parallels South Mineral Creek the creek, and is drivable by 2WD. Just past the campground, the road becomes 4WD.' San Juan road status (as of October 26, 2026): 'South Mineral Creek* | 585 | Weather Dependent | Weather Dependent | No gate; therefore are not regularly monitored.*' FR 585 is not listed among the roads damaged in the October 22-25, 2026 flooding; the forest-wide flood alert still warns of widespread road damage.
Closures: none for the campground. The FS page shows a 'Site Closed' badge, consistent with the season ending in September.
Price gate: $40 a night, under the $50 gate.
Website: also https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165661 (Scan & Pay listing), linked from the FS page.

Waterfront (stored creekside, consistent): FS 'located along South Mineral Creek'; on Esri imagery the creek's open gravel channel runs along the south edge of the loops, ~10-30 m from the southern sites (the western part is in mountain shadow on the image).
Pin 37.80613,-107.77423 is at the campground's east entrance off FR 585, ~100 m NE of the FS point 37.8056,-107.7751, which sits in the loops; both on the campground, fine.
